consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the June 12, 1992 show at Knickerbocker Arena was a standout performance, particularly praising the energy and execution of the second set. The Scarlet > Fire sequence is frequently highlighted as a major highlight, showcasing the band's synergy and improvisational skills.
